items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was sitting in with Frank Foster who would be sitting in with Wardell Grey and Stony Nightingale

ctx.x: Let’s talk about you’re in high school, when do you start to hit the scene and what was your peer group when you did that in Detroit?

Well, it really wasn’t my peer group, I was way over my head. I was sitting in with Frank Foster who would be sitting in with Wardell Grey and Stony Nightingale and all those names that you probably would never hear in your life.
Well let’s put those names on the record. It’s important.
